stem.text: A toy drone emits a sound of constant frequency $800\,\text{Hz}$. The speed of the sound in the air is $330\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
The drone moves along a straight path directly towards an observer and then continues in a straight line directly away from the observer. The speed of the drone is constant.

stem.alt: Diagram of a toy drone on a dashed horizontal path with an arrow pointing right, and an observer standing below the path to the right of the drone.

stem.text: What is the velocity of the drone when the frequency of the sound heard by the observer is $850\,\text{Hz}$?
